subject: a coral-colored sea fan
pose: fan rising from a low reef base

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Paint one coral-colored sea fan in transparent watercolor, its broad branching silhouette rising from a low blue-gray reef base. Keep the branches delicate but grouped into readable rhythms, avoiding an intricate lace wall. Pale aqua washes gather near the bottom and fade upward into warm-white paper. The image should feel airy, quietly luminous and naturally balanced. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
